spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation

**¶1:** The infinite Divine itself, which is the origin of all wisdoms.

**¶2:** The Divine proceeding that brings forth all spiritual life — the first operation of the Divine flowing outward to vivify.

**¶3:** The mediating Divine principle that governs the celestial kingdom within the natural degree — the sovereign of heavenly good made present even within the outermost plane — [GAP-1] proceeding from the sovereign origin of all wisdom.

**¶4:** The good that is loved by all wisdom, which is held in highest acknowledgment.

**¶5:** The primordial [GAP-2: the celestial human projected into spiritual combat] — the Divine Human in its first form, sent forth to confront falsity directly.

**¶6:** [GAP-3: this is] the animating [GAP-4: Divine truth that orders all things], the origin of spiritual life, who has distributed his five interior faculties — the spiritual senses of perception — each to its proper degree and function.

**¶7:** The Divine ordering principle that constructs the form of heaven, resplendent in Divine truth.

**¶8:** The sustaining axis of Divine truth that connects every degree from inmost to outmost — [GAP-5] [GAP-6].

**¶9:** [GAP-7: This is the radiance of Divine wisdom itself] — that is, the delivering power, for it liberates everyone who belongs [GAP-8] to it by means of the truths it speaks into the understanding.

**¶10:** The pure and uncorrupted affection for truth [GAP-9] through which wisdom is received without distortion.

**¶11:** The Divine wisdom implanted within the interior understanding — the one who rouses those who lie in the sleep of spiritual ignorance, and who gathers back into unity all the scattered goods and truths that falsity has dispersed throughout the divided mind.

fills.explanation: The Third Ambassador, governing the celestial kingdom within the natural world, is described in the spiritual reading as "proceeding from the sovereign origin of all wisdom" — in the Kephalaia's register, a lower emanation reflecting its source is called its "image," yielding "the image of the King of the lights."

The spiritual reading identifies this as "the celestial human projected into spiritual combat" — the Primal Man (Ohrmizd) of Manichaean cosmology; "First Man" is the standard Kephalaia designation, confirming the editor's reading.

The definite article "the" fits the consistent pattern of the enumeration list where each entry begins with "the" followed by a divine name; the spiritual reading's "this is" is the interpretive frame, while the natural text uses the article, confirming the editor.

The spiritual reading identifies this as "the animating Divine truth that orders all things" — in Manichaean cosmology this is the Living Spirit (Mihryazd), the standard designation in the Kephalaia, confirming the editor's reading.

In Manichaean cosmology, the Pillar of Glory is consistently identified with "the Perfect Man" (Sroshtav) as a secondary name; the spiritual reading's emphasis on connecting every degree from inmost to outmost corresponds to the Perfect Man as the complete form through which light ascends.

The spiritual reading identifies this as "the radiance of Divine wisdom itself," which in the Kephalaia's register is Jesus the Splendour (Yišō Ziwa), the standard ninth emanation in Manichaean cosmological lists, confirming the editor's reading.

The spiritual reading states "everyone who belongs to it" — in the Kephalaia's natural register, "whoever belongs to him" completes the phrase describing Jesus the Splendour freeing those who are his own through his words of truth.

The Virgin of Light's most well-attested epithet in Manichaean cosmology is "the judge" — she who discerns and selects souls; this corresponds to the spiritual reading's "pure and uncorrupted affection for truth through which wisdom is received without distortion," since the pure affection for truth is the faculty that judges and discerns truth from falsity.
